hero.kicker: Industrial supplier of green coffee · Since 1996
hero.headline: Green coffee at industrial scale
hero.subhead: We supply the food industry, roasters and importers with large-scale volume, consistent quality and global logistics.

historia.title: A family-run company from Chiapas, since 1996
historia.lead: Three generations doing the same thing: reading every harvest and standing behind every lot we ship.
historia.p1: We started in 1996, in Chiapas, buying coffee from the region's growers and learning to read each harvest. Thirty years later we are still a family business, now in its third generation, with more than 100 people on the team and an agronomy crew working in the field, alongside the people who grow the coffee.
historia.p2: That is 30 years of experience backed by installed capacity and logistics that guarantee a sustainable supply for any industry requirement. We serve everyone from the specialty roaster to large industry, with global coverage and logistics we manage end to end.

proceso.title: From the mountains to the world
proceso.lead: We follow the coffee through every stage, from the high-altitude farm to the bag ready for export.

steps.title: The highlands
steps.caption: Chiapas coffee grows on high slopes, where the bean ripens slowly and gains its character.

steps.title: The grower
steps.caption: Our agronomy team works with hundreds of growers on their own land, harvest after harvest.

steps.title: Processing
steps.caption: Washed, naturals and European and American preps: each profile is handled with a defined method.

steps.title: Consolidation
steps.caption: We bring lots from many hands into even volumes, with traceability back to origin.

steps.title: Green coffee
steps.caption: It ships graded, bagged and ready for roasters and exporters in any country.

productos.title: Green coffee of Mexican origin
productos.lead: Grades and preparations for every destination. The spec sheet makes the difference, not the photo.

arabica.name: Arabica
arabica.intro: Our core bean, grown at altitude. Available in different grades and preparations depending on your destination and the profile you need.
grades: Strictly High Grown (SHG) and High Grown
Naturals and Washed — Prime and Good

robusta.name: Robusta
robusta.intro: Mexican Robusta for blends, soluble coffee and espresso: more body and caffeine. The variety most in demand from industry, available in steady volume.

productos.note: See the full grades and parameters table below; also available as a PDF.

calidades.title: Grades and reference parameters
calidades.lead: Classification of green / gold coffee from Chiapas. Final parameters are set by contract according to your requirement.

rows.uso: Bright, complex acidity, natural sweetness. Specialty roasters and microlots.
Very clean, with notable acidity and body. Demanding European market.
Good profile, with medium acidity and body. High quality.
Clean cup with defined acidity. Industry and commercial roasters.
More body, intense notes and more caffeine. Blends, soluble and espresso.
Body, sweetness and fruity notes from the natural process. Commercial and industrial.

calidades.note: Final parameters (% stain, screen size and defect count) are set by contract per client. Specialty coffee = 80+ SCA points. Altitude ranges are general market references.

certificaciones.title: Certifications that back every lot
certificaciones.lead: We work with coffee certified to the standards your clients recognize.

items.name: USDA Organic
items.blurb: Coffee grown without synthetic agrochemicals, under the United States organic standard.

items.name: OCIA
items.blurb: International organic certification that verifies crop management from the field.

items.name: Fair Trade
items.blurb: Fair trade: terms and prices that sustain growers' income.

certificaciones.note: We display the official seals once verified with the client; never an approximate logo.

diferenciadores.title: Why work with CASEMEX?
diferenciadores.lead: Your biggest risk is not getting the coffee you need, at the quality and on the timeline your operation demands. We are the industrial supplier that turns it into certainty.

blocks.title: Supply at industrial scale
blocks.body: A consolidated network of hundreds of growers and installed capacity guarantee a sustainable supply, not only in a good harvest.

blocks.title: Consistent quality and an in-house lab
blocks.body: We map samples and cup every lot in our own laboratory, so the profile you approved is the one you get next time.

blocks.title: Certified traceability and food safety
blocks.body: Processes accredited by Global Markets (GFSI): every lot arrives with traceability to origin, certified growers and the certification your market requires.

blocks.title: Global logistics we manage ourselves
blocks.body: Worldwide reach. We deliver lots or containers to the destination you need, or FOB at port as you prefer.

accreditation.title: Processes accredited by Global Markets (GFSI)
accreditation.intro: Global Markets (GFSI) is the endorsement that guarantees our processes meet international food safety and traceability standards, giving large industry the confidence to work with us.

origenes.title: Our regions in Chiapas
origenes.lead: We source across the state's coffee-growing zones, each with its own altitude, climate and cup profile.
origenes.mapTitle: Map of the coffee-growing zones of Chiapas where CASEMEX sources green coffee

regions.name: Soconusco
regions.note: Pacific coast, high-grown coffee beside the Sierra Madre.

regions.name: Sierra Madre
regions.note: High slopes and cool climate, clean and sweet profiles.

regions.name: Frailesca
regions.note: Central valleys and hillsides with volume production.

regions.name: Norte / Selva
regions.note: Humid zones in the north of the state, shade-grown coffee.

origenes.note: We'll confirm the exact zones and their profiles with you before every operation.
